record.dic_text:
0471 'Elyaqiym' {el-ya:-ki:m'}

源自 0410 和 06965; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Eliakim 12; 12

以利亞敬 或 以利亞金 = "神舉起" 或 "神建立"
1) 希勒家的兒子, 希西家的家宰 (#王下 18:26; 19:1-2|)
2) 約西亞的兒子, 法老立他作王 (#王下 23:34|)
3) 協助尼希米的祭司 (以利亞金) (#尼 12:41|)
record.edic_text:
0471 'Elyaqiym' {el-yaw-keem'}

from 0410 and 06965;; n pr m

AV - Eliakim 12; 12

Eliakim = "God raises" or "God sets up"
1) the son of Hilkiah, master of Hezekiah's household
2) Josiah's son, enthroned by Pharaoh
3) a priest who assisted Nehemiah
